toegepas.voor: 'n Hartoorplanting duur ure lank en die pasiënt
toegepas.na: 'n Hartoorplanting duur ure lank, en die pasiënt
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two main clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two main clauses (''n Hartoorplanting duur' / 'die pasiënt moet').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both clauses have their own subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 comma is required and nothing else changes.

toegepas.voor: kieme in 'n wond die infeksie veroorsaak
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'die infeksie' points back to an infection the text never mentioned; the general noun without the article reads naturally.
toegepas.fout: 'die infeksie' points back to an infection the text has not named.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The general noun reads naturally and the claim (germs in a wound cause infection) is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: 'n Oop bors laat vir ure lank kieme by die wond kom.
toegepas.na: Terwyl die bors ure lank oop is, kan kieme by die wond kom.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'n Oop bors laat ... kieme by die wond kom' is wooden; the same meaning reads more naturally with a time clause.
toegepas.fout: ''n Oop bors laat ... kieme by die wond kom' is wooden.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The time clause says the same thing naturally, and the permissive 'laat' already meant 'kan'.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'gevind dat' echoes English 'found that'; 'ontdek dat' is the natural Afrikaans and matches the lesson's own word 'ontdekkings'.
toegepas.fout: 'gevind dat' copies English 'found that' and in Afrikaans can read as 'were of the opinion that'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'ontdek dat' is the natural verb for a discovery and fits the lesson's 'ontdekkings' without moving the meaning.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma after the relative clause separates the two verbs 'inloop' and 'moet' and makes the sentence easier to read.
toegepas.fout: Two verbs of different clauses ('inloop' and 'moet') meet without a comma.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma between the clause verbs follows AWS practice and makes the sentence easier to read.

toegepas.voor: Daarna kon dit veilig gebeur en bloed kon later gestoor word.
toegepas.na: Daarna kon dit veilig gebeur, en later kon bloed gestoor word.
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two main clauses, and fronting 'later' gives the more natural Afrikaans word order.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two main clauses, and 'bloed kon later' is a stiff order.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required and fronting 'later' is the natural Afrikaans order, with the same facts in the same sequence.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The sentence means the X-ray picture just described; 'so 'n prent' makes that reference clear.
toegepas.fout: ''n prent' is vague where the X-ray picture just described is meant.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'so 'n prent' ties the sentence to the X-ray picture without adding or changing anything.

laat_vaar.voor: kan die nuwe hart in 'n liggaam klop wat aan infeksie sterf
laat_vaar.na: kan die nuwe hart klop terwyl die liggaam aan infeksie sterf
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The relative clause hung on 'n liggaam' is clumsy for Grade 6; 'terwyl' keeps the meaning and reads more clearly.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The extraposed relative clause is ordinary Afrikaans and the original image of the heart beating inside a dying body reads well; the proposal is a lateral move that drops 'in'.

na_skrywer.voor: bloed van 'n ander mens se liggaam kry
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'van 'n ander mens se liggaam' is roundabout; 'van 'n ander mens' says the same and matches the study text.
na_skrywer.fout: 'van 'n ander mens se liggaam' is slightly roundabout in a glossary definition.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This rewords a [begrip] definition beyond a spelling or grammar fix, so only the writer may change it, across every lesson that uses it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer
